events.title: CVE-2026-67279: MikroTik RouterOS Mikrotik RouterOS Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow Vulnerability
events.summary: An improper enforcement in MikroTik RouterOS lets unauthenticated clients open a session channel and send exec requests, which can be chained to the more severe CVE-2026-86060 for full exploitation.
events.why_it_matters: The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 6.9 and can be chained to CVE-2026-86060, which has a CVSS of 9.2. Both are listed on the KEV, indicating known exploitation. Defenders should patch MikroTik RouterOS promptly to prevent unauthenticated exploitation.

claims.text: CISA lists CVE-2026-67279 and CVE-2026-86060 as exploited in the wild.
CVE-2026-86060 is rated 9.2 (critical) under CVSS 4.0 by the CNA that assigned it, the highest of the 2 scored CVEs here.
FIRST's EPSS puts the chance of CVE-2026-86060 being exploited in the next 30 days at 6.4%, the highest of the 2 CVEs here.
